text:
mike: kicking off staged rollout for release v2.13.0 -> 12% sample (route: api-text-gen). scheduled in change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. canary variant pinned to v2.13.0-canary. deploy-bot: queued 6 instances in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted. job id 1712354321.

olivia: quick smoke looks ok so far — 95th latency +2ms, error rate delta +0.01% compared to baseline. no regression on embeddings.

sasha: saw 3 x 502s on edge-27 around 22:12, not obviously model-related. pulling edge logs now.

nate: tagging for safety — please pin fallback to v2.12.9 and enable route diversion if needed. also FYI there was a small schema change in chat.function payloads in this release.

mike: stop/go criteria: hold if error delta > 0.5% OR 95th latency increase > 20ms OR >5% 5xx on any edge node. quick vote?

olivia: +1 go. metrics stable. :thumbsup:

sasha: :thumbsup: recommend enabling detailed logs on edge-27 and a temporary circuit-break threshold.

nate: :thumbsdown: hold — I see a schema mismatch in a small subset of tool-call requests. sending example below.

nate: ```json
{"request_id":"r-12ab","route":"/chat/tool-call","body":{"input":"search","functions":["search"]}}
```

deploy-bot: progress update: 12% traffic shifted to v2.13.0-canary across eu-west-1. instances healthy: 5/6. KV cache warm: 84%.

mike: nate — can you confirm whether the mismatch causes errors or just parsing warnings?

nate: parsing warnings turn into 400s for a subset of customers using legacy SDKs. impact small (~0.02% of requests) but concentrated.

olivia: suggestion: proceed for unaffected routes and divert /chat/tool-call to v2.12.9 fallback while we patch. propose moving to 15% global but pin that route to fallback.

mike: ops consensus check — react with :+1: to proceed with diversion, :no_entry: to hold until fix.

sasha: :+1:

olivia: :+1:

nate: :no_entry: — still prefer hold until a quick hotfix is merged; worried about regressions for legacy customers.

mike: decision: proceed to 15% traffic for everything except /chat/tool-call. divert that route to v2.12.9 fallback, open rollback window until 22:30 UTC. if errors exceed 0.5% in the window we roll back traffic to 0% for v2.13.0. updating release notes and ops runbook. https://internal/releases/v2.13.0

deploy-bot: action taken — traffic split updated: 15% global to v2.13.0-canary; route-level diversion /chat/tool-call -> v2.12.9. rollback window open until 22:30 UTC. alarms configured: error_delta_threshold=0.5%.

sasha: monitoring dashboards show no new spikes after diversion. will post another update at 22:20 UTC.

mike: thanks — keep eyes on latency and 5xx. nate, please coordinate the hotfix with runtime and ping when ready.

nate: will do. opening PR now and will coordinate canary redeploy when merged.

mike: noted. closing thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
